gloss: same kind; same species; of the same type

definitions.gloss: same kind; same type; of the same species
definitions.explanation: Belonging to the same category or type. Used in biology to mean 'the same species,' in law and business for 'the same kind of offense / product / case,' and in everyday speech for 'the same type' generally.

examples.japanese: {同種|どうしゅ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{動物|どうぶつ}→動物：01480_doubutsu⟧。

examples.english: There have been similar cases in the past.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{商品|しょうひん}→商品：01436_shouhin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{同種|どうしゅ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{他|た}→他：03381_ta⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{製品|せいひん}→製品：01445_seihin⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦{価格|かかく}→価格：00147_kakaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{安|やす}い→安い：00464_yasui⟧。
examples.english: This product is cheaper than other products of the same kind.

examples.japanese: {同種|どうしゅ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{犯罪|はんざい}→犯罪：03569_hanzai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{繰|く}り{返|かえ}した→繰り返す：02051_kurikaesu⟧⟦{場合|ばあい}→場合：01704_baai⟧、より⟦{重|おも}い→重い：00804_omoi⟧⟦{刑罰|けいばつ}→刑罰：20566_keibatsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{科|か}される。
examples.english: If the same type of crime is repeated, a heavier penalty is imposed.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{同|どう}→同〜：03962_dou⟧ ('same') and ⟦{種|しゅ}→種：28584_shu⟧ ('kind; species'). Contrasted with ⟦{異種|いしゅ}→異種：20480_ishu⟧ ('different kind; different species'). Typically followed by ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ to modify a following noun: {同種|どうしゅ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧〜 ('the same kind of ~').

USAGE:
Register is neutral to slightly formal. Appears in scientific, legal, and journalistic writing. In everyday conversation, ⟦{同|おな}じ→同じ：02857_onaji⟧⟦{種類|しゅるい}→種類：01560_shurui⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧〜 ('the same type of ~') is often more natural.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {同種|どうしゅ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{動物|どうぶつ}→動物：01480_doubutsu⟧: animals of the same species
- {同種|どうしゅ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{事件|じけん}→事件：01568_jiken⟧: a similar incident; the same type of case
- {同種|どうしゅ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{犯罪|はんざい}→犯罪：03569_hanzai⟧: a similar crime
- {同種|どうしゅ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{商品|しょうひん}→商品：01436_shouhin⟧: the same kind of product
- {同種|どうしゅ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{被害|ひがい}→被害：02572_higai⟧: similar damage / harm
- {同種|どうしゅ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{業務|ぎょうむ}→業務：09630_gyoumu⟧: the same type of work
- {同種|どうしゅ}⟦{業界|ぎょうかい}→業界：13129_gyoukai⟧: the same industry

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{同|おな}じ→同じ：02857_onaji⟧⟦{種類|しゅるい}→種類：01560_shurui⟧: the same type — plain, conversational equivalent
- ⟦{同様|どうよう}→同様：01654_douyou⟧: similar; the same — broader; 'the same as'
- ⟦{同類|どうるい}→同類：12058_dourui⟧: the same category; kindred — often of people (can have a disparaging tone, like 'birds of a feather')
- ⟦{類似|るいじ}→類似：14672_ruiji⟧: similarity; resemblance — similar but not necessarily the same
- ⟦{異種|いしゅ}→異種：20480_ishu⟧: different kind / species — opposite
- {同種類|どうしゅるい}: the same kind — fuller, somewhat redundant variant
